speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for coming in today. You mentioned persistent bleeding after your wisdom tooth extraction and a history of easy bruising; to better understand the underlying cause, could you describe exactly how long the bleeding has continued and whether you have noticed any other unusual bleeding spots?

Also, do you have a family history of similar bleeding problems, and have you ever taken aspirin, ibuprofen, or any other blood thinners?

Finally, have you experienced frequent nosebleeds, bleeding gums when brushing, or large bruises appearing without any injury?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A (Factor VIII deficiency).

Given the family history of a male relative with similar bleeding and joint swelling, combined with your young age and persistent post-extraction bleeding, I am requesting results for a Coagulation Profile (PT/PTT/INR) and a Factor VIII activity level to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Coagulation_Profile (PT/PTT/INR); Factor_VIII_Assay
